intro.text: A captain of the Palace Guard in Kholinar.

items.text: During the siege of Kholinar, Queen Aesudan culled the Palace Guard, claiming some had disobeyed her. Sidin and other guards were locked in the palace garrison, the door altered to lock from outside, and seemingly forgotten. When it was opened during the battle for the city, Adolin barely recognized the filthy Sidin, and was heartened that not everyone around the queen had been corrupted.

Sidin rallied his fellow prisoners to help. Strangely, they thought they had been held only a few days and had eaten just three times, though Adolin said it had been weeks. Adolin had them act as reserves and see the medics.
Adolin then assigned Sidin and half a platoon to follow King Elhokar, since they had resisted the palace's influence and knew the ground better than the Wall Guard.

appearance.text: A fairly young man, presumably lighteyed, who normally keeps clean-shaven. He wears a uniform with captain's knots on the shoulders.
